display.purpose: The empty-state heading only. The largest text in the product; never exceeded.

title.purpose: Brand name, agent name, modal headings.

body.purpose: Chat messages, ledger entries, dialog copy. Dense by default.

label.purpose: Uppercase, tracked panel headings and control labels.

mono.purpose: Anything literal: editor source, paths, node ids, status readouts.

small.purpose: Dense controls below body text: tabs, side tabs, quick prompts, chips.

nano.purpose: Smallest tier: outline-kind badges and compact role labels.

shadows.name: floating-surface-dark
shadows.purpose: Menus, modal, and toasts on dark; detaches a dismissible layer from the page.

shadows.name: floating-surface-light
shadows.purpose: The same float shadow on the light theme, retuned for paper.

shadows.name: node-selection-glow
shadows.purpose: Cobalt glow under a selected graph node; the one glow effect.

shadows.name: orb-halo
shadows.purpose: Soft halo around the agent orb; widens to 6px / 0.28 while busy.

motion.name: grid-ease
motion.purpose: Opening/closing the sidebar or agent panel reads as a drawer.

motion.name: panel-fade
motion.purpose: Panel contents fade out as their column collapses.

motion.name: orb-pulse
motion.purpose: Agent orb halo widens while the agent is busy.

motion.name: agent-tick
motion.value: agent-dot-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite, staggered +0.16s per dot
motion.purpose: Three cobalt dots beside the agent status line while it is inferring; reduced motion holds them lit instead.

motion.name: stream-caret
motion.purpose: Cobalt caret while the assistant reply streams.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Narrows the agent panel to 320px and the sidebar to 210px; all four regions stay present.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled button, used once per surface (Send, modal Confirm).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent-strong, #4668d8); color: #fff; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-strong, #4668d8); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.55; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong-hover, #3f61cc); border-color: var(--accent-strong-hover, #3f61cc); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #7c9cff); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Toolbar control: transparent until hover, then Hover Ink; active state gains the accent.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Toggle files"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M3 5h18M3 12h18M3 19h18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--text-dim, #8b98ab); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #1a212c); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #7c9cff); } .ds-icon-btn.is-active { background: var(--bg-active, #222b3a); color: var(--accent, #7c9cff); border-color: var(--border, #202836); } .ds-icon-btn.is-danger { color: var(--err, #f85149); } .ds-icon-btn.is-danger:hover { background: rgba(248, 81, 73, 0.14); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Wide dashed call-to-action in the sidebar foot; goes solid green once wired.
components.css: .ds-ghost-btn { width: 100%; padding: 7px; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed var(--border, #202836); color: var(--text-dim, #8b98ab); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-ghost-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #1a212c); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); border-color: var(--accent, #7c9cff); } .ds-ghost-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #7c9cff); } .ds-ghost-btn.is-wired { border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.55); color: var(--ok, #3fb950); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: OpenCode connection chip with a status dot: green halo online, red offline.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-inset, #080a0f); border: 1px solid var(--border, #202836); color: var(--text-dim, #8b98ab); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11.5px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #7c9cff); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #7c9cff); } .ds-pill .ds-pill-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-faint, #5d6878); } .ds-pill.is-online { color: var(--text, #e6edf3); } .ds-pill.is-online .ds-pill-dot { background: var(--ok, #3fb950); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.16); } .ds-pill.is-offline .ds-pill-dot { background: var(--err, #f85149); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(248, 81, 73, 0.16); }

components.name: Side Tab
components.description: Equal-width segmented navigation (Files / Outline / Gaps); only the active tab is filled.
components.css: .ds-side-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 8px 0; } .ds-side-tab { flex: 1; padding: 6px 4px; border: none; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-faint, #5d6878); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-side-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #e6edf3); } .ds-side-tab.is-active { background: var(--bg-active, #222b3a); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); }

components.name: Chat Message
components.description: Assistant bubble: uppercase role label over a Raised Ink card with a hairline border.
components.html:
Graph Engineer
This flow has no failure branch after the write. Should a timeout retry, or surface an error?
components.css: .ds-msg { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; max-width: 100%; } .ds-msg-role { font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.7px; color: var(--text-faint, #5d6878); } .ds-msg-body { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--bg-elev, #11151d); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, #1a212c); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Composer Input
components.description: Recessed Well Ink textarea; focus is a border shift to cobalt with no ring.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-composer" rows="2" placeholder="Ask the Graph Engineer to draft, refine, or interrogate a graph…"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-composer { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; resize: vertical; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--bg-inset, #080a0f); border: 1px solid var(--border, #202836); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-composer::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint, #5d6878); } .ds-composer:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #7c9cff); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-right notification; the elevated layer, so it carries the float shadow.
components.css: .ds-toast { padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--bg-elev, #11151d); border: 1px solid var(--border, #202836); box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font-size: 12.5px; max-width: 320px; animation: ds-slide-in 0.2s ease; } .ds-toast.is-err { border-color: rgba(248, 81, 73, 0.5); } .ds-toast.is-ok { border-color: rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.4); } @keyframes ds-slide-in { from { transform: translateY(8px); opacity: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
Siren Studio is a notebook an engineer keeps open next to the thing they are building. The diagram is the page; the surrounding chrome is the desk. Surfaces are built from a ladder of near-black inks, rules are hairline, and type is small and exact, because the notebook's job is to let a person read a system without ceremony and then point at what is wrong. Nothing is decorated. The only saturated color is a cobalt signal that says something here is live.

The mood is calm precision. Density is high and deliberate — four regions (files, editor, graph, agent) coexist in one viewport at 13.5px — but weight is carried by spacing and the ink ramp rather than by borders, fills, or badges. Motion is limited to the two transitions the work actually needs: the panel grid easing when a region opens or closes, and the splitter tracking the pointer with easing explicitly disabled so the drag never lags. The interface is dark-first, and its light theme is a true peer — the same structure drawn on paper, not an inversion.

The world is explicitly not a dashboard and not a chat app. There are no cards floating on gradients, no glass, no oversized display type, no accent washes behind content. The graph is the only thing allowed to be visually complex; everything around it is a ruled margin.
keyCharacteristics: Four-step near-black ink ladder for depth; shadows only for true floats.
A single restrained accent (Cobalt Signal) reserved for state, never decoration.
Two typographic registers: system sans for the interface, mono for anything literal.
Dense, flat, hairline-ruled regions under a fixed 3-row app grid.
Dark-first with a fully realized light peer theme.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt Signal marks one current thing per region — the focused field, the open tab, the selected node. It is never a background wash, never a gradient, and never used to decorate a static element.

rules.name: The Deep-Fill Rule
rules.body: The only filled surface that carries white text is Cobalt Signal Deep. It never lightens toward the bright accent on interaction, because that would drop the label to 2.6:1; hover deepens it instead (5.54:1).

rules.name: The Ink Ladder Rule
rules.body: Depth is expressed by stepping the surface ramp (Code/Well → Void → Panel → Raised), one step per layer, and never by stacking two borders or two shadows. If a surface needs to feel higher, step the ramp; do not reach for the shadow token.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Sans carries the interface; mono carries anything literal — a path, a filename, a node id, a version, a source line. If a value could be pasted into a terminal unchanged, it is set in mono.

rules.name: The No-Display-Type Rule
rules.body: Type never exceeds 18px and never uses a display or editorial face. Size is not how this interface creates hierarchy; position, the ink ramp, and uppercase labels are.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Depth is the ink ladder first. Surfaces at rest are flat; a shadow is reserved for a layer the user can dismiss (menu, modal, toast).

rules.name: The No-Stack Rule
rules.body: Never combine a shadow with a heavy border, and never place two floating shadows in the same stack. One float, one shadow, one hairline.

dos: Do express depth with the ink ladder (Code/Well → Void → Panel → Raised) before reaching for the shadow token.
Do reserve Cobalt Signal for exactly one current thing per region — focus, selection, active tab, live connection.
Do set anything literal (paths, filenames, node ids, source, status readouts) in the mono face, and interface chrome in sans.
Do use the documented radius scale (3/4/5/6/7/8/10px, pills 999px) — master 10px, controls 7px.
Do use 1px Rule Line / Hairline Rule borders and change only border-color on focus, never a glow or outer ring.
Do keep text at or below 18px and carry hierarchy with position, uppercase 11px labels, and ink weight.
Do keep both themes fully realized; the light theme remaps surfaces to Paper Mist / Paper White and swaps the accent to #3366d9 for contrast.
donts: Don't use Cobalt Signal as a background wash, gradient, or decoration — it is a state color, not a brand fill.
Don't add shadows to panels or cards at rest; only menus, modals, and toasts may float.
Don't stack two borders or a border plus a heavy shadow on one edge.
Don't pure-white the primary text on dark; Graphite Ink (#e6edf3) keeps the ink ladder readable.
Don't introduce display/editorial typefaces or sizes above 18px; this is an Operate surface, not a marketing page.
Don't add glass, gradients, glassmorphism, or an accent glow outside the graph stage and agent orb.
Don't animate panels on hover or add transitions to splitter drags — the splitter must track the pointer with easing off.
